newsitem.title: UK: TABLE - General Cable Q1 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - General Cable Q1 loss widens.

text.p: NOTE - The company said its overall retained loss was 11.6 million stg versus 5.9 million stg.
Q1 residential telephone lines rose 29 percent to 177,900, cable television customers rose 30 percent to 154,600 and business exchange lines increased 56 percent to 35,800 versus the year-ago period.
Equity revenues, the group's share of revenues of operating companies, jumped 47 percent to 30.5 million stg.
Full company name - General Cable Plc. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
